limiterDetail: Wind is 0.6–5.5 kt across all grounds, the calmest of the day. The main limiter is current: Tara (1.1–1.5 kt) and Turda (0.9–1.2 kt) stay strong all 24h. Coron, Culion and Galoc are MARGINAL only on a light shower around 2 PM (0.6 mm). Winds pick up to 7–10 kt on several grounds from about Wed 1 AM.

pagasa.status: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA.
pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. New since this morning: Tropical Cyclone Warning, Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi), Signal #1 , Tue 20 Oct 10:55 AM PHT, for Batanes, Cagayan and Catanduanes. It forecasts strong to gale-force gusts for most of the country Thu 22, and a gale warning may follow for the northern and eastern seaboards of Luzon. The last MIMAROPA item is still General Flood Advisory #4 (Final), Tue 20 Oct 5:24 AM PHT.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: New: PAGASA has named Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi). It is still outside the Philippine area, 1,385 km east of Central Luzon, and is forecast to pass east and north of Batanes Thu 22 to Fri 23, then leave by Sat 24. Signal #1 is only up for Batanes, Cagayan and Catanduanes, and nothing is issued for Palawan or Calamian. But PAGASA's 10:55 AM PHT bulletin says the northeasterly winds plus Rosal's outer edge bring strong to gale-force gusts to Romblon and other areas tomorrow and to most of the country on Thursday 22. That backs up ECMWF's windy Thu 22 and Fri 23, and gusts at exposed grounds could run above the model's 16–18 kt.

The supply timing is unchanged: ABOVE NORMAL today, softening Wednesday, BELOW NORMAL Thu 22, shortage risk ELEVATED. Two 7-day shifts: Fri 23 is now the worst day (12 kt, gusts 18; Thu 22 eased slightly to 11 kt, gusts 16), and Sun 25 rain doubled to ~18.8 mm (heavy).
Snapshot: 8 GOOD, 6 MARGINAL, 2 POOR (this morning 6 GOOD, 10 MARGINAL, 0 POOR). Wind is light everywhere, and Tara and Turda went back to POOR on current, as this morning's report expected.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). Shortage risk stays ELEVATED for the Wed 21 to Mon 26 catch, felt Thu 22 to Tue 27, with upside risk if Rosal's gusts reach Calamian Thu–Fri. Tara and Turda run BELOW NORMAL locally on current. Today is the last ABOVE NORMAL day, so buying ahead today and tomorrow morning still makes sense.

bestWindow.headline: This afternoon to late evening, about 2–11 PM
details: 2–5 PM: Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot start nearly calm (0.6–0.8 kt) on 0.1–0.4 kt current, the model's calmest combined hour is about 2 PM at Nangalao, and Linapacan, Barangonan, Binudac and Galoc sit at 2.4–4.7 kt on 0.2–0.5 kt current.
6–11 PM: the calmest stretch of the 24h. Coron, Culion and Galoc drop to 0.3–2.4 kt, Linapacan to 1.6–2.4, Alava and Binudac under 3, and Maglalambay and Panlaitan to 2–3.3 kt.

Keep boats off Tara and Turda all 24h (1.1–1.5 kt current). Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot get 9–10 kt around Wed 4–6 AM, and Tara, Turda and Decabobo build to 8–11 kt from Wed 8 AM. Wednesday morning is easiest at Coron, Culion, Galoc and Ciron (3–5 kt).
